statement: The preserved Choi-Lam-derived perturbed rational quartic has an independently accepted exact global certificate with28 isolated real roots and original-objective gap about1.2936e-5 below the requested1e-4. assumptions: Exact empirical optimality is not future physical fidelity or an acquired stationarity promise.
